description: Idea Lab new-project workflow. 14 canonical flow steps (idea_intake, structured_spec, beginner_summary, support_matrix_check, blueprint, scaffold_request, acceptance_tests, implementation_plan, build_test_verifier, smoke_plan, bounded_repair_plan, final_report, evidence, training_remains_blocked) and 11 UI states. evaluate() refuses any state where: (1) unsupported features are hidden -> BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM; (2) external setup caveats are hidden -> BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM; (3) Build It is enabled before the support matrix check passes -> BLOCKED_MISSING_SUPPORT_CHECK; (4) the 'Working' label is enabled before build_verifier + tests + smoke have ALL passed -> BLOCKED_FALSE_SUCCESS. training_eligible stays False; record never opens source mutation.
